entries.title: Work with several parts no longer closes before its last part is filed
entries.body: When you approve a plan with several pieces, Firstmate files every piece at once, including the last one. A task that groups several parts stays open while Firstmate answers the news that its last part closed, and Firstmate checks the task's goal against its parts first, so a missing piece is filed instead of the work closing as finished.
entries.noPicture: This changes which tasks Firstmate files and when a grouping task closes, not how any view looks.
